# Reference assets

The face model is the reference's `face-hp.js` (high resolution), stored locally as `face.json`.
These assets were retrieved from Valentin Marmonier's 2015 WebGL experiment, https://vaalentin.github.io/2015/ (source repository: https://github.com/vaalentin/2015), for this local study and recreation. Original author: Valentin Marmonier (GitHub: vaalentin).

Original public paths below are relative to https://vaalentin.github.io/2015/app/public/:

- smoke.png: img/sprite-smoke.png
- smoke-still.png: img/part-smoke.png
- matcap.jpg: img/matCap.jpg
- matcap-shiny.jpg: img/matCap-shiny.jpg
- raleway.woff2: fonts/raleway/raleway-regular-webfont.woff2
- ambient.mp3: sounds/background.mp3
- wind.mp3: sounds/wind.mp3
- face.json: 3D/face-hp.js
- rocks.json: 3D/rocks.js

The public repository does not include a project license file. These files retain their original attribution; their availability in the public repository does not itself grant redistribution rights. Raleway is the original project's bundled font.

The face and rocks geometry files are JSON (legacy Three.js formatVersion 3.1), despite their original .js extensions.
